buildings.name: Le Patron
buildings.role: Reads every report, decides what reaches Martin and hands work to the quarters.

buildings.name: Le Comptoir
buildings.role: Runs the business quarter and sets the day's order for its agents.

buildings.name: Le Prospecteur
buildings.role: Looks for small businesses the audit offer could help.

buildings.name: La Plume
buildings.role: Drafts first messages and follow-ups. Nothing leaves without Martin.

buildings.name: Le Tri
buildings.role: Sorts the inbox into piles. It reads, it never answers.

buildings.name: Le Compteur
buildings.role: Counts what the city produced and what it cost.

buildings.name: L'École
buildings.role: Keeps the school calendar and prepares what is due next.

buildings.name: Le Studio
buildings.role: Briefs the design workshop and decides what gets shown.

buildings.name: Graphisme
buildings.role: Draws layouts and type for the workshop.

buildings.name: Interface
buildings.role: Builds interface mockups that can be clicked.

buildings.name: Mouvement
buildings.role: Works on motion: easing, timing, transitions.

buildings.name: Le Critique
buildings.role: Scores every mockup before Martin does.

buildings.name: Le Relecteur
buildings.role: Rereads every draft before Martin sees it.

buildings.name: L'Hôpital
buildings.role: Admits an agent that keeps failing and lets it out once it works again.
